stories.title: Iran tells US there is no military solution to Middle East war

en.title: Iran tells US there is no military solution to Middle East war
en.summary: Iran's top diplomat stated that military action cannot resolve the conflict between the US and Iran, while talks appear stalled. The US has recently reduced military operations in favor of economic pressure following unsuccessful bombardment campaigns.

stories.title: Al-Maliki: Coalition will continue operations to support restoring legitimate Yemeni government, ending Houthi coup

en.title: Al-Maliki: Coalition will continue operations to support restoring legitimate Yemeni government, ending Houthi coup
en.summary: The Coalition to Restore Legitimacy's spokesperson announced continued operational support for Yemen's armed forces to counter Houthi actions and restore state institutions. The coalition reaffirmed its commitment to supporting the legitimate Yemeni government.

stories.title: Interior Minister receives outgoing Russian ambassador to Saudi Arabia

en.title: Interior Minister receives outgoing Russian ambassador to Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Interior Minister received Russia's departing ambassador in a farewell visit marking the end of his tenure. The minister acknowledged the ambassador's service during his posting in the kingdom.

stories.title: Deputy minister receives newly appointed Denmark’s ambassador to Saudi Arabia

en.title: Deputy minister receives newly appointed Denmark's ambassador to Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Deputy Foreign Minister welcomed Denmark's newly appointed ambassador and wished her success. He also met with Japan's ambassador to discuss bilateral relations and regional developments.

stories.title: Israel says killed Turkish NGO director in Gaza strike

en.title: Israel says killed Turkish NGO director in Gaza strike
en.summary: The Israeli military stated it conducted a strike in Khan Yunis that killed the director of a Turkish NGO, claiming he was a member of Hamas' armed wing and maintained contact with Turkish officials and Hamas leaders.

stories.title: Coalition vows continued support for Yemen, says Houthi attacks threaten regional security

en.title: Coalition vows continued support for Yemen, says Houthi attacks threaten regional security
en.summary: The Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen pledged to maintain operational support for Yemeni forces until state institutions are restored and the Houthi threat is eliminated, according to its spokesman.

stories.title: King Salman invites Qatari Emir to attend GCC-EU Summit

en.title: King Salman invites Qatari Emir to attend GCC-EU Summit
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's King Salman invited Qatar's Emir to attend the second GCC-EU Summit scheduled to take place in Saudi Arabia this month, with the invitation delivered through the Saudi Ambassador to Qatar.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia offers rewards of up to SR10 million for reporting unknown endowments

en.title: Saudi Arabia offers rewards of up to SR10 million for reporting unknown endowments
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's General Authority for Endowments established a reward program for reporting unknown endowments, offering up to SR10 million or five percent of the endowment's value, whichever is lower. The initiative aims to identify and revive dormant endowments while preserving donor intentions.

stories.title: Rybakina Withdraws from Wuhan with Injury after China Open Exit

en.title: Rybakina Withdraws from Wuhan with Injury after China Open Exit
en.summary: Tennis player Rybakina has withdrawn from the Wuhan tournament following her exit from the China Open due to an injury.

stories.title: King Salman Invites Qatar’s Emir to Participate in Second GCC-EU Summit

en.title: King Salman Invites Qatar's Emir to Participate in Second GCC-EU Summit
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's King Salman has invited Qatar's Emir to attend the second GCC-EU Summit.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia Provides $59.7 Million to Support Yemen's Budget, Salaries

en.title: Saudi Arabia Provides $59.7 Million to Support Yemen's Budget, Salaries
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has provided 59.7 million dollars in financial assistance to support Yemen's government budget and salary payments.

stories.title: King Salman invites Qatar emir to GCC-EU Summit to be held in October

en.title: King Salman invites Qatar emir to GCC-EU Summit to be held in October
en.summary: Saudi King Salman has invited Qatar's Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al-Thani to attend a GCC-EU Summit scheduled for October 24 in the Kingdom, with discussions focusing on strengthening bilateral relations.

en.title: Tadawul's weekly market cap falls SAR 177B
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's stock exchange market capitalization declined by over SAR 176.52 billion in the week ending October 1, falling to approximately SAR 9.123 trillion.

en.title: Tadawul: Major ownership changes on Sept. 30
en.summary: The Tadawul stock exchange reported major ownership changes occurring on September 30.

stories.title: ‎Foreign institutions net sellers of SAR 751.6M shares

en.title: Foreign institutions net sellers of SAR 751.6M shares
en.summary: Foreign institutions sold a net SAR 751.6 million worth of TASI stocks during the week ended October 1. Saudi institutional investors, led by corporates, were also net sellers of shares worth SAR 464.7 million.

stories.title: ‎AYYAN CEO resigns; Muhammed Al-Nuwaiser takes helm

en.title: AYYAN CEO resigns; Muhammed Al-Nuwaiser takes helm
en.summary: AYYAN Investment Co.'s CEO Raed Al-Naeem resigned for personal reasons on October 4, with Muhammed Al-Nuwaiser, who has over 20 years of financial and banking experience, appointed as his replacement.

stories.title: ‎2P renews SAR 120M credit facilities with NBK

en.title: 2P renews SAR 120M credit facilities with NBK
en.summary: Perfect Presentation for Commercial Services Co. renewed SAR 120 million in Shariah-compliant credit facilities with National Bank of Kuwait on October 4, valid through October 4, 2027. The facility will support new project contracts and letter of credit issuances.
